name: ui-layouts-color-picker
title: Hex Color Picker
description: A labelled colour field that shows the current colour as a small swatch. Clicking it opens a popover with a saturation square, a rainbow hue slider, a hex input and a copy button.
use: A settings form needs users to choose a brand or accent colour and see its exact hex value.
avoid: The popover needs room below the trigger, and clipboard copying depends on browser permissions.
a11y: The trigger and copy button carry hidden labels and the picker is keyboard reachable, but panel motion and toasts ignore reduced-motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small row pairs the word Color with a rounded rectangular swatch in the chosen colour. The open panel is a dark card holding a large gradient square, a thin rainbow hue bar, and a hex text field beside a copy button.
behaves: Clicking the swatch opens the panel; dragging the rings in the square and on the hue bar recolours the swatch live, and the hex field can be typed into. The copy button writes the hex to the clipboard, and clicking outside closes the panel.
customise: Pass the colour, its change handler and a label; an eyedropper toggle adds a pipette button. Panel size, swatch corners and copy styling are class edits.
weight: light: A swatch, a popover and one gradient square; idle until opened.
